description: Feed rate stepped from 0.5 to 1.2 L/h at 30 h, then reduced to 0.7 L/h at 34 h. Causes a substrate pulse and a steeper product formation slope.
Dissolved oxygen drops below 35 % saturation for ~4 h. Growth and product formation are suppressed during the limitation.
pH probe drifts upward at ~0.008 pH units/h starting at 42 h. True process pH remains controlled; measured pH is unreliable.
